objective: Give the owner explicit, scheduler-safe model load/unload controls, richer bounded image overviews, clean final chat answers with visible thinking state, and punctuation-aware TTS text so hidden reasoning never reaches the operator or voice output.
non_goals: Do not bypass the shared GPU scheduler, reduce the mandatory 2048 MiB VRAM headroom, or force cloud models into local memory.
Do not persist chat content, hidden reasoning, screen pixels, generated audio, API keys, or benchmark artifacts.
Do not add a new model, dependency, training corpus, or public/production promotion in this maintenance slice.
Do not run repeat, soak, frozen-SHA, or full release verification unless the owner explicitly requests it.
contracts: POST /v1/resources/models/control accepts only an allowlisted model id, load or unload action, source owner.desktop, and ownerConfirmed=true; it never accepts arbitrary commands or model names.

A load action uses the existing scheduler lease and fails with a bounded resource error when admission would violate headroom; an unload action releases only the selected provider lease after active work completes.
Cloud vision is reported as cloud-ready and never pretends to load local VRAM.
Chat final output is plain answer text only; hidden reasoning, system/developer prompt text, analysis headings, separators, and control tokens are removed or fail closed before moderation and TTS.
Conversation status exposes the existing turn state so the desktop can render a non-persistent thinking indicator while a turn is running.
Vision summaries are bounded Vietnamese overviews covering scene, layout, entities/state, readable text, visual cues, and uncertainty using only evidence in the captured frame.
TTS normalization creates explicit sentence boundaries around dashes and keeps the OmniVoice quality profile at natural 1.0x speaking rate.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Python standard library, existing scheduler/provider interfaces, existing Electron typed preload IPC, and existing Vue/CSS; no new dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Resource dashboard shows a load and unload action for each configured local model, reports pending/error feedback, and refreshes truthful state after the operation.
Runtime unit tests prove malformed control payloads, cloud no-op behavior, scheduler denial, and successful provider warmup/unload paths.
A regression test proves a model response containing the screenshot's '--- **Phân tích hành vi:**' suffix yields only the final answer and never exposes the analysis.
Desktop chat shows 'Hina đang suy nghĩ…' while the turn state is thinking and clears it on completion, interruption, or failure.
Vision and TTS tests cover detailed overview bounds, dash/punctuation normalization, and fixed natural OmniVoice rate.
Fast unit/build/smoke commands pass and all one-off generated artifacts are removed before commit.
